title: Austin Street Improvements and Drill Ground Access
summary:
• **Street Improvement Funding**: The council approved $800 to gravel streets leading to the drill grounds, addressing concerns about road conditions to this military training facility.

• **Water Street Project**: An ordinance was passed to gravel Water Street from Congress Avenue eastward to the city limits, with funding increased from $500 to $800 to also include graveling East Avenue from Olean Street to State Street.

• **Contentious Votes**: A small group of aldermen (Caldwell, Townsend, Wilson, and Platt) consistently opposed the street improvement measures, but the majority supported infrastructure development for the growing city.
